mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level directly reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift capital toward risk assets.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day S&P 500 returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1200 thousand units signal robust consumer confidence and economic momentum, triggering immediate positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as markets price in sustained expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1200.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Joint decline in unemployment rate and strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 150,000) indicates a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Interaction term (UNRATE * PAYEMS) has negative coefficient in regression of 20-day returns, or Rank IC for interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Low inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL < 250) signal the Federal Reserve's accommodative policy stance, supporting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL < 250, or Rank IC for signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) directly correlates with improved corporate earnings outlook, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through sustained economic expansion.
failure_condition: Rank IC for GDPC1 as predictor of 20-day S&P 500 returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100 (index base 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC for signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Joint low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 250) and dovish rate policy (FEDFUNDS < 2.5%) create a strong accommodative environment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days through amplified policy support.
failure_condition: Interaction term (CPIAUCSL * FEDFUNDS) has negative coefficient in regression of 20-day returns, or Rank IC for interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS > 500,000 million dollars) indicate consumption-driven economic expansion, supporting corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS > 500000.0, or Rank IC for signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
